en.title: Companies Regulations Schedule 1 and NPIO Regulations s.33(5): "Objectives" of the Registrar defined by s.9(1) of the Companies Regulations; the objectives are in s.10(1)
en.summary: Both definitions point to "section 9(1) (Registrar's Objectives and Functions)". s.9 is "Appointment of Registrar". The objectives are set in s.10(1) ("(the Registrar's Objectives)"), whose heading is the one in brackets. The bracketed heading saves the meaning.
en.correction: Please replace "section 9(1)" with "section 10(1)" in both definitions.
